left.says: Card: "Shove and the Break Finisher cost you 1 AP less, never below 1 AP." effects[0]: {"op":"action_cost","action":"shove","value":-1}

The hook's own comment says so (a.ts:346: "the Shove Link is 1 AP already, so its discount gave nothing"), which is why the 1 Guard was added. Only Break is discounted. effects[] also has no entry for the 1 Guard the card and the hook (stat 'shove_guard') give.
left.rightSide: Card: say "The Break Finisher costs you 1 AP less (never below 1). A Shove that moves its target gives you 1 Guard." Data: drop the shove action_cost effect and add the Guard effect.
left.verifier: Confirmed with nuance. On the technique pad Shove is flat 1 AP (techniques.json shove ap value 1; apFor -> actionAp(u,'shove',1)) and a.ts:347 discounts only when base > 1, so the Shove Link is never cheaper; only Break is. The card is not literally false ("never below 1 AP") but the Shove half is empty. Two things the finder missed: (1) the legacy reducer action combat/shove (combat.ts:1694, base 2 AP) still exists and IS discounted 2 -> 1; (2) the card wording is Leon's recorded ruling of 10 Nov (commit 59731ee; skeleton-2.0-PLAN.md:133 "Shove and Break cost 1 AP less, and a Shove that moves its target gives 1 Guard"), so rewording is Leon's call, not a plain fix. Data part stands: effects[0] shove value -1 has no floor and there is no effect for the 1 Guard (stat 'shove_guard').

left.says: "You can't be flanked." (II: "You and the allies next to you can't be flanked.")
left.truth: The hook only supplies a cover tile or the shield's -5 inside attack_preview (b.ts:319-328). The engine's one flanking rule, the ranged Pressure bonus for a hit "past its cover" (physical/pressure.ts:80 flanksCover, :90 flank_bonus; techniques.json:54), reads coverTileFor directly and never asks the perk, so a holder at cover is still flanked for Pressure. The spec's reading of the perk (lines 2368-2372) promises only the cover and the shield, not immunity to flanking.
left.rightSide: Either the card drops "can't be flanked" and keeps the cover sentence (follows the spec's reading), or flanksCover asks the perk. Leon's call; the spec as written supports changing the card.
left.verifier: Facts confirmed, but it is a judgement call, not a clear mismatch. The spec defines flanking as cover not counting (line 505), and the perk honours that: b.ts:319-328 supplies a cover tile or the shield's -5 (spec 2368-2372, item 126). The gap is a second consumer: pressure.ts:80 flanksCover / :90 flank_bonus (spec item 935 "+1 past cover the target stands against", never called flanking in the spec) reads coverTileFor directly, so a holder at cover gets the hook's cover against the shot and still takes +1 Pressure "past its cover" from the same hit. Also Sidestep's "counts as flanking" (links.ts:116 ignoreCover) is not blocked, but the perk is ranged-only by its second sentence. Spec is silent on Pressure for this perk; either have flanksCover ask the perk or leave as is. Leon's call; low priority.

left.says: Card: 'bonuses to Attributes and Skills from gear don't work on you'. Comment: 'its price, no gear bonuses, is steep now that weapons give so much'.
left.truth: The handler cancels only worn slot items' skill_mod / skill_bonus effects (perks/h.ts:95-100). A scan of data/items.json and data/weapons.json finds no such op on any item (items carry armour_bonus, defense_bonus, movement_bonus...; weapons carry hit_bonus, first_shot_bonus...), and none of those is denied to the holder. So the gear half of the downside does nothing today, and weapon bonuses still apply; spec item 249 (line 5287) says the same ('items.json has none yet').
left.rightSide: Leon's call, then engine or comment: either the engine denies gear bonuses the comment has in mind (weapon hit bonuses, armour pieces' stat bonuses), or the character.ts comment stops justifying the 2 points by a price nobody pays.
left.verifier: Facts confirmed, but this is a design observation, not a text error. items.json effect ops are armour_bonus, defense_bonus, movement_bonus, carry_bonus etc., with no skill_mod or skill_bonus; weapons.json items carry no effects ops. So the handler at h.ts:95-100 cancels nothing today, exactly as spec item 249 (line 5287) and the handler's own comment say. The card ('bonuses to Attributes and Skills from gear') is vacuously true and agrees with spec and engine. The only contestable text is the rationale in the character.ts:197-198 comment. Should be playerVisible false; Leon's call on whether the price should bite.

left.truth: Engine physical/rules.ts:64: Momentum is kept only when the Guard technique is up, the Parry won, or Guard soaked part of that hit (comment: Leon, 10 Nov 2026; spec section 14 item 1004 raised it). classes.json Fighter resource rule agrees with the engine: "unless you Parry it or your Guard takes part of it". By the source-of-truth rule the spec body stands until the ruling is recorded, so this is an engine-ahead-of-spec item needing Leon's confirmation: record the ruling and close item 1004 (then fix both spec lines), or revert the engine. reviewOfSecondPass.verdict:
Not ready to merge as it stands.

**What holds.** In a sample of about 60 of the confirmed findings, every fix I looked at is present, correct and on the right side. That includes all the engine-wrong and player-visible ones in the visible list. The engine hunks are small. On a scratch export of the branch, the validator and the spec-table check print 0 errors and the four guard test files pass.

**What blocks it.**
1. **Wrong-field bindings.** The placeholder pass left at least 20 texts bound to a field that only happens to hold the same number today. Examples: three percentages read the Overreach threshold; four Echo costs read an Overreach penalty; Call steps and soul-module stages read another step's numbers. The new guard cannot see this, and its mutation test is true by construction.
2. **Crawler-Blooded test.** It still passes with the Blessing-patron lookup removed, so it does not pin spec item 114.
3. **`sigil.ts:415`.** The new `foe` test also moves pc-side casters that are not characters onto the enemy heal and shield bases. That direction is not declared and not tested.
4. **Scope.** The branch is far wider than a list of fixes: every numbered data text was rewritten and 31 engine modules got a new import line. That will conflict with the parallel refactors, and nothing enforces the import on new modules.

**Smaller points.** Four cards and two spec rows were settled where the verifier asked for Leon's ruling. Several new data fields are mirrors nothing reads. CLAUDE.md's changed lines are true as far as I checked; the one gap is that the Mana line omits the rules 1.24 MP cost of a Pump.

**Not reviewed.** The roughly 140 findings the fixer never received are untouched. The `engineBehaviourChanged` list reached me cut off after four entries, so I checked the rest of the engine diff against spec item 1512 instead.
